listen-and-introduce-yourself.label: Listen and Introduce Yourself
listen-and-introduce-yourself.summary: Say a nationality and the language you speak using simple identity patterns.

listen-and-introduce-yourself-choice.title: Choose a language sentence
listen-and-introduce-yourself-choice.hint: Choose the sentence about language ability.

listen-and-introduce-yourself-fill.prompt: Choose the verb that completes the sentence about language.
listen-and-introduce-yourself-fill.hint: Use the sentence pattern practiced in this lesson.

help.concept: The blank needs the action that connects the speaker with a language.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

listen-and-introduce-yourself-listen.title: Hear a nationality
listen-and-introduce-yourself-listen.prompt: Listen, then build the identity sentence you hear.
listen-and-introduce-yourself-listen.hint: Listen for the identity pattern and nationality.

help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.

listen-and-introduce-yourself-build.prompt: Arrange the words to say “I am Haitian.”
listen-and-introduce-yourself-build.hint: Use the identity pattern before the nationality.

listen-and-introduce-yourself-write.hint: Use the language name that appears throughout the lesson.

nationality.title: Mwen se ayisyen / ayisyèn
nationality.bodyMarkdown:
You can use **Mwen se…** with a nationality:

- **Mwen se ayisyen.**
- **Mwen se ayisyèn.**
- **Li se ameriken.**

At this level, the goal is to recognize and use the identity pattern, not to memorize a long list of nationalities.

language.title: Mwen pale…
language.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Mwen pale…** to say what language you speak:

- **Mwen pale kreyòl.**
- **Mwen pale anglè.**
- **Mwen pale fransè.**

The same structure works with many language names.

combine.title: Identity + language
combine.bodyMarkdown:
You can now give two simple facts about yourself:

**Mwen se ayisyen. Mwen pale kreyòl.**

Keeping the sentences short makes them easier to hear, say, and reuse.
